title: projects
description: `cpa project ls --json`, and every `cpa project add|rename|move|folder|rm --json` after its change (docs/23 §3.1, docs/25 §8): this Mac's projects by slot, the same 1-9 the device shows. No local path. A project is a named group; linked (2026-10-26; an older cpa leaves it out) says whether a code folder is linked, folder is that folder's last path component (never a path), null when unlinked. ok is false only when a linked folder is gone.
